title: Belavadós Visitable Location Catalogue
design_notes: Built for Belavadós dark steampunk fantasy: infrastructure, transit, divine containment, ichor economies, guilds, and living NPC schedules.
D&D 5e equipment expectations are mapped into storefronts: weapons, armor, adventuring gear, tools, mounts/vehicles, trade goods, lifestyle expenses, and magic item access.

Capital Cities may include portal network buildings. Cities and Capital Cities may include skyship docks. Underwater settlements use pressure-sealed guest architecture and aquatic substitutes for land agriculture and stables.
Locations are suitable as pins, map regions, NPC workplaces/homes/visiting destinations, services containers, and rerollable generator pools.
